name: streams
description: Untangles the interleaved work in a Claude Code session (prompts, mid-turn asides, subagents, loops) into colour-coded streams with a live navigator pane, a status bar of pills and per-stream focus.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Write debug.json into the plugin folder every few seconds (for troubleshooting).

chatStyle.title: Stream chat style
chatStyle.description: How a stream's own view draws its chat: full (as the session draws it, with markdown, highlighted code and diffs) or compact (one line per row). The ≡/▤ button in the pane switches it for the session.

completionCheck.title: Completion check
completionCheck.description: Ask Haiku whether streams that show WAITING or stalled are in fact finished (one small call for all of them, again only after something new happens in a stream). A finished one shows DONE, checked ✓.

autoArchiveHours.title: Auto-archive after (hours)
autoArchiveHours.description: A finished stream (by its status or the completion check) with no activity for this many hours archives itself; it stays under "archived" in the pane, restorable. Never a running, waiting, looping or failed stream. 0: off.

relayUrl.title: Relay address
relayUrl.description: The Claudeflow relay address your phones and tablets connect through. The hosted one by default; set your own (https://relay.<you>.workers.dev) if you deploy one. Empty: no remote.
